== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The dragons{{!}}Dragon [[Monarch]], known as [[Seshethkunaaz]], is the King of all Dragons{{!}}King of Dragons and ruler of the eastern [[Ashwind continent]]. He leads a coalition consisting of the gold and green [[dragons]], seeking to reclaim The Empire{{!}}the Empire that was once under [[dragon]] rule. Although he possesses immense spiritual presence, he often travels through the desert appearing as a human boy with tanned skin, dark hair, and golden eyes. While he holds an admiration for humans, he harbors a deep disdain for human civilization due to its preference for the weak over the strong. He is described as a being of [[destruction]], though he has been known to adopt human children and act as a critic of the Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons' governance. His Authority{{!}}authority is significant enough that his presence can be felt like a restrained earthquake, and he maintains vast treasuries, such as the shifting desert [[vault]]. He has also utilized methods to fuse with a [[Blood Shadow]] to enhance his power during his ascension from [[Sage]] to [[Monarch]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The dragons{{!}}Dragon [[Monarch]] maintains a sense of dignity that prevents him from engaging in tricks. He holds a position of power within his realm, which includes a shifting desert [[vault]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He utilizes a [[technique]] that employs sandstorms to exert Authority{{!}}authority over space.}}
